course_name_original: Numerical Control of Production Machines and Equipment Control
course_name_en: Numerical Control of Production Machines and Equipment Control

learning_outcomes.text: Student should gain a basic knowledge in NC-programming and CAD-CAM programming.
He also becomes familiar with properties and inner structure of CNC systems.

syllabus_topics: NC and CNC systems, basic features and abilities.
NC programming, ISO coding, CAD-CAM systems.
Structure of an NC program, path programming, G-codes.
Coordinate systems on the machine tool, reference point and offsets.
Coordinate system transformation to machine tool axes.
Inaccuracy of machine tool, measuring methods and compensations.
Open system architecture of a CNC system.
Differences between CNC for cutting or forming machines.
Introduction: functional assemblies of NC machines and their connection
Connection to machine drives and machine kinematics
Laboratory tasks to be performed on CNC machines
PLC application, laboratory tasks to be performed on CNC machines
3D simulation models of machines with a control system emulator
An example of a model with a control system emulator in NX
Demonstration of a comparison of a simulation and real machining
bibliography: presentations and support available at http://web.rcmt.cvut.cz/users/cerny/
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
